descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As Team Lead in Network Security Edge Defense you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible. Description of the area The Edge Defense team belongs to the Network Security organization, a cornerstone of Information Security. We provide the technologies and services that protect the entire network against IT Security incidents and digital threats. The core stack of this team includes:
• Perimeter Defense: Network Firewalls and DDoS Mitigation
• Modern Architecture: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) services
• Cloud Network Security in AWS, Azure, GCP ​ Job Responsibilities
• Strategic Edge Vision & Modern Architecture: Define the digital roadmap for Perimeter Defense (Firewalls, DDoS) and Modern Architecture (Zero Trust) across the most external facing network segments, both on-premise and in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Operational Excellence & Automation: Drive an "Automation First" mindset for external network security, leveraging APIs and scripting to replace manual work with scalable security code ("Shift Left").
• Cloud-Native Security: Lead the security strategy for the complex multi-cloud footprint (AWS, Azure, GCP), focusing on securing the perimeter and network edge in the cloud.
• Lifecycle Management & Compliance: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Edge Defense technologies, from discovery to global scale, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, excluding GxP for non-manufacturing focus).
• Business Translation: Connect technical security performance of the external network to broader business outcomes, ensuring security is an accelerator for R&D and other non-manufacturing environments.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Deeply understand customer and business needs to shape the strategic direction and digital roadmap for the Edge Defense product, focusing on delivering high-value outcomes. Who You Are Experience
• 5+ years of experience in Information Security is an asset
• 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry is an asset
• 5+ years of experience in people leadership, product/service management, program management or a similar role, with a proven track record of building high performing teams ​ Education
• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field or equivalent experience
• Professional Information Security certifications are a plus (e.g. CISSP, CISM) ​ Technical Skills
• Proven background and solid foundation in Information Security specifically in Network Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet), NAC (e.g., Cisco ISE), and ZTNA solutions
• Experience in multi-cloud environments is a plus
• Operational Excellence: Strong understanding of ITIL frameworks (Incident, Change, and Problem Management) and Continuous Improvement methodologies
• Automation
